//: GE-011-005. Every GitHub environment the OIDC trust policies name, declared so a test can check they exist. A role whose trust names an environment that does not exist is a role nothing can assume — the failure is silent, and it presents as a permissions error at the moment of a deploy rather than at the moment of the mistake.
//check: tests/security/oidc-trust.test.mjs asserts this file and roles.tf agree. .github/workflows/ops-status.yml asserts these exist on GitHub, because only a token can see that.

environments.name: aws-read
environments.why: The read-only inventory role. Bound to an environment rather than a branch so the subject is stable if the default branch is ever renamed.

environments.name: engine-production
environments.why: The Studio deploy role. An environment condition additionally requires whatever reviewers that environment carries — which is where the human approval GE-011-005 asks for is actually enforced, rather than merely observed by CI.
